T: The sword is hidden. The dumplings are not.
D: A legendary warrior's stolen sword draws a young noblewoman into a world of martial arts and secrets.
P: Serve the tea when the fight breaks out in the teahouse.
S: Steamed pork and cabbage dumplings with black vinegar and chili oil
Pork and cabbage dumplings with ginger and spring onion, steamed 8 minutes in bamboo baskets, with black vinegar and chilli oil.
the fight on top of the bamboo forest

Baby bok choy, snow peas and bamboo shoots stir-fried fast in a smoking wok with garlic, oyster sauce and sesame oil, served in a bamboo steamer basket. Halve 4 baby bok choy and trim 150g snow peas. Drain a 225g tin of bamboo shoots. Heat a wok until smoking, add 2 tbsp oil and 4 sliced garlic cloves and stir 10 seconds. Add the bok choy stems, snow peas and bamboo shoots and toss 1 minute, then the leaves with a splash of water. Add 2 tbsp oyster sauce and a few drops of sesame oil, toss and serve in a bamboo basket.
Cumin and chili lamb skewers grilled until charred at the edges
Lamb shoulder cubes rubbed with cumin, chilli flakes and salt, threaded on skewers and grilled hot until charred.
M: Duck legs salted overnight and roasted until the skin crackles, shredded into steamed pancakes with cucumber, spring onion and sweet hoisin. Rub 4 duck legs with 2 tsp salt and a little five spice and leave uncovered in the fridge overnight. Roast skin up on a rack at 180C for 90 minutes, then at 220C for 10 minutes until crisp. Shred with two forks. Steam 20 Chinese pancakes for 3 minutes. Cut a cucumber and 4 spring onions into thin batons. Serve everything with a bowl of hoisin to build your own.
Yu Shu Lien's steamed whole fish
Whole snapper steamed with ginger, topped with soy, scallion and sizzling oil

Whole snapper scored, steamed over ginger and spring onion for 12 minutes, finished with smoking hot oil poured over fresh spring onion, soy sauce and coriander. Score a 1.2kg whole snapper and lay on sliced ginger and spring onion. Steam for 12 minutes. Pile fresh shredded spring onion and coriander on top, pour over 3 tbsp soy, then 4 tbsp smoking hot oil so it sizzles.
W: Fried glutinous rice balls filled with red bean paste and coated in sesame

Glutinous rice flour mixed with sugar and hot water into a dough, wrapped around balls of red bean paste, rolled in sesame seeds, fried at 160C until puffed and golden. Mix 250g glutinous rice flour and 60g sugar with about 200ml hot water into a dough. Wrap around small balls of red bean paste, roll in sesame seeds and fry at 160C until puffed and golden.
K: Jasmine pearl green tea steeped in a pot and poured into small cups

Hand-rolled jasmine pearl green tea steeped gently at 80C, poured into small cups and refilled through the meal with dried longan on the side. Heat 1L water to about 80C, or boil it and leave it to stand for 5 minutes. Warm a teapot with hot water and tip it out. Add 4 tsp jasmine pearl green tea, pour over the water and steep for 2 minutes. Pour into small cups. Refill the pot with fresh water for a second and third steep. Serve a bowl of dried longan on the side.

s.note: Steamed pork and cabbage dumplings with black vinegar and chili oil
s.how: Mix 400g pork mince with 2 cups shredded wombok, 1 tbsp grated ginger and 2 spring onions. Fill 30 dumpling wrappers, pleat and steam 8 minutes in bamboo baskets. Serve with black vinegar and chilli oil.
